# llms-full.txt — not published

The full-text corpus for this site is **deliberately not published**.

## Why

A complete text dump of the Telfer Wiki would be a complete roster of the family,
**including living people**. The wiki names living people as plain text on their
relatives' pages — by design — so a faithful dump cannot exclude them, and no filter
applied to the output can undo that.

The owners have therefore chosen not to publish it. This is not an oversight and not a
temporary outage.

## What is published instead

- **[/llms.txt](https://telferwiki.com/llms.txt)** — the site map for AI assistants and
  language models: what this site is, how it is structured, and where the useful pages are.
- **[/sitemap-0.xml](https://telferwiki.com/sitemap-0.xml)** — every published page,
  including every person page. Anything genuinely public is listed there.

## If you need the full corpus

Please use the sitemap. If you have a research need that genuinely requires the
assembled corpus, contact the site owner via
[/contact/](https://telferwiki.com/contact/).

---

*This file exists so that tooling which conventionally probes for `/llms-full.txt`
receives an honest answer instead of a dead end. It contains no family data.*
